svg.title: One word the training text has and one it never had, as the trainer's merges come: each frame is a merge that changes one of them, numbered in the order learned (1,792 in all)
svg.text: _ is a space. The merges on a log scale. Each word is merged as encode() merges it: the pair learned first, again and again.

g.title: Before any merge each word is its bytes, one symbol each: '_heavens' 8, '_Prospero' 9.
Merge 2 of 1,792: 'h' + 'e', the pair counted most often at that point, becomes symbol 257; '_heavens' is now '_' 'he' 'a' 'v' 'e' 'n' 's'.
Merge 18 of 1,792: 'e' + 'r', the pair counted most often at that point, becomes symbol 273; '_Prospero' is now '_' 'P' 'r' 'o' 's' 'p' 'er' 'o'.
Merge 26 of 1,792: 'e' + 'n', the pair counted most often at that point, becomes symbol 281; '_heavens' is now '_' 'he' 'a' 'v' 'en' 's'.
Merge 38 of 1,792: '_' + 'he', the pair counted most often at that point, becomes symbol 293; '_heavens' is now '_he' 'a' 'v' 'en' 's'.
Merge 113 of 1,792: 'r' + 'o', the pair counted most often at that point, becomes symbol 368; '_Prospero' is now '_' 'P' 'ro' 's' 'p' 'er' 'o'.
Merge 212 of 1,792: 'v' + 'en', the pair counted most often at that point, becomes symbol 467; '_heavens' is now '_he' 'a' 'ven' 's'.
Merge 357 of 1,792: '_' + 'P', the pair counted most often at that point, becomes symbol 612; '_Prospero' is now '_P' 'ro' 's' 'p' 'er' 'o'.
Merge 394 of 1,792: '_he' + 'a', the pair counted most often at that point, becomes symbol 649; '_heavens' is now '_hea' 'ven' 's'.
Merge 525 of 1,792: '_hea' + 'ven', the pair counted most often at that point, becomes symbol 780; '_heavens' is now '_heaven' 's'.
Merge 615 of 1,792: 'p' + 'er', the pair counted most often at that point, becomes symbol 870; '_Prospero' is now '_P' 'ro' 's' 'per' 'o'.

Merge 1,790 of 1,792: '_heaven' + 's', the pair counted most often at that point, becomes symbol 2045; '_heavens' is now '_heavens'. No later merge changes either: '_Prospero', which the training text never had, stays 5 pieces it did have.
